messages:
Elaine H: Quick sync — SI partners pipeline. We need one canonical mapping doc + a short ROE. I propose buckets A/B/C for co-sell priority.
Ravi P: +1. Can we tie buckets to ARR thresholds and region? e.g. A: >$500k global, B: $100-500k, C: <$100k.
Mike L: Also need explicit SFDC lead tags and handoff rules. Suggest fields: LeadSource=SI, SI_Partner=[name], CoSellBucket=[A/B/C], SI_Contact_Email.
Elaine H: OK. Workflow idea: SI-originated lead gets an "SI_Pending" owner until MQL; AE gets ownership post-demo. If AE steps in earlier, SI retains referral credit per ROE. @Ravi P fyi.
Jordan T: Sounds reasonable. For hardware/on-prem deals, legal and capacity certification must be looped in at intro. Add a POC readiness checklist.
Ravi P: For cloud marketplace motions, require marketplace listing verification and marketplace-friendly pricing in the quote before joint PR. No co-announcement pre-SOW.
Mike L: Draft ROE (quick):
- SI-originated leads: tag + 14-day exclusivity for initial outreach
- If no qualifying activity by Redwood in 14 days, SI can re-engage or escalate to AE
- Deal credit: default 70/30 to SI if they carry the opportunity through close; exceptions for strategic accounts
- Marketing/PR: co-announcements only after closed-won and comms sign-off
- Marketplace/hardware: additional gating (listing verified, capacity cert, NDAs)
Elaine H: I'll put a short playbook page and an SFDC field mapping doc in Confluence: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/Partnerships/pages/si-co-sell-playbook — feedback welcome.
Ravi P: Can you also stub an SFDC report named SI_Pipeline_Weekly that shows CoSellBucket by ARR and region? We need visibility for GTM.
Elaine H: Yes — I'll create the report and share. Weekly sync Friday 10am PT — calendar invite sent. :calendar:
Jordan T: One more: hardware partner deals must attach a capacity certification doc before demo. I'll share checklist in the playbook.
SI_Partner_Bot: New partner added: Titan Systems — welcome! :tada:
Mike L: Great. Target: playbook page + SFDC tags + report by EOD Wednesday so sales/AE pods can start tagging.
Elaine H: On it. Thanks everyone.
